# Security Policy

## Supported Versions

Only the latest version of the skills in this repository is currently supported and receives security updates.

| Version | Supported          |
| ------- | ------------------ |
| Latest  | :white_check_mark: |
| < 1.0.0 | :x:                |

## Reporting a Vulnerability

We take security vulnerabilities seriously. If you find any security issues in this repository, please do **not** report them via public GitHub issues or discussions.

Instead, please report vulnerabilities by contacting the maintainer privately at:
*   Email: **wenchiehlee.investment@gmail.com**

We will acknowledge your report within 48 hours and work with you to resolve the issue as quickly as possible.
